parameters.query:
WITH aclaracion_elegida AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (child.parent_task_id)
    child.id AS child_id,
    child.parent_task_id AS parent_id,
    child.output AS child_output
  FROM tasks AS child
  JOIN tasks AS parent ON parent.id = child.parent_task_id
  WHERE parent.status = 'blocked'
    AND child.status = 'done'
    AND child.consumed_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY child.parent_task_id, child.updated_at ASC, child.id ASC
),
marcar_consumida AS (
  UPDATE tasks
  SET consumed_at = now()
  WHERE id IN (SELECT child_id FROM aclaracion_elegida)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE tasks AS parent
SET status = 'pending',
    input = jsonb_set(parent.input, '{text}', to_jsonb((parent.input->>'text') || E'\n\nAclaración recibida: ' || ae.child_output)),
    updated_at = now()
FROM aclaracion_elegida ae
WHERE parent.id = ae.parent_id
RETURNING parent.id;
